facts.fact: 罗莉骑着Celeste，随令人生畏的seraph达拉驶向遍布dryad和militia的森林，去查证"人类正被带进提罗奈尔"——这是她仅剩的线索。
facts.anchor: I was running Celeste next to a feared seraph, toward a forest filled with dryads and militia, to look for clues that humans were being brought into Tironaill.

facts.fact: 分手前达拉抽出一把银匕首交给罗莉防身，教她"能刺就刺喉咙"；他让她与两马藏进岩缝，自己独自去查人声，并要她承诺原地不动。
facts.anchor: He unsheathed one of his silver daggers and handed it to me. “Aim for the throat if you can.” He drew a line across his throat with his finger.

facts.fact: 等了几个小时达拉未归，罗莉违背承诺下马去寻他；Celeste刨地抗议、Astorath用头顶她，都拦不住。
facts.anchor: I dismounted Celeste, my legs aching from the amount of time I spent in the saddle. She pawed at the ground in protest at what I was about to do, and Astorath pushed against me with his head as if he were trying to keep me from leaving.

facts.fact: 罗莉循火光摸到营地：三个蒙面人围着篝火，达拉被绑在树上——鼻孔流血、左眼肿胀；他的目光却已找到躲在橡树后的她。
facts.anchor: One of the men shifted to the side, and my eyes grew wide at the sight of another man tied to a tree, bruised and bleeding from his nose. His left eye was swollen, but he still looked up at me as I peered from behind the oak.

facts.fact: 关键异象：三人分食一条面包、懒得理他，而达拉的伤口没有像seraph本该有的那样愈合。
facts.anchor: All three men eventually sat and passed around a loaf of bread, ignoring Darragh behind them. His wounds were not healing as a seraph’s should.

facts.fact: 瘦绑匪（后文称E）说天快黑、今晚没法把达拉押回"老板"那里，三人轮流看守；捆住达拉的是E施的结界。
facts.anchor: “It’s getting late. We can’t take him back to the boss tonight. The sun is almost down.”

facts.fact: 罗莉割绳被E抓住脚踝拖向火堆，她反身把银匕首扎进E大腿、直没至股骨并割破动脉；E惨叫松手，她起身逃入林中。
facts.anchor: As E slowly bent down toward me, I sat up and planted the silver dagger into his thigh. I didn’t stop pushing until the blade hit his femur. He screamed and dropped my ankle, falling to the forest floor.

facts.fact: 达拉脱困后向罗莉道歉（她暗想这是头一回有男人真心又道歉又道谢），并解释：罗莉逃走后他"解决了那三个seraph"，怒气一直未消。
facts.anchor: Had you not, I don’t know what would have happened. I let my emotions linger from taking out those three seraphs after you fled.

facts.fact: 今晚回不了城（天黑林险、militia惯于夜行），达拉说王室担心的是罗莉；他将派渡鸦Stolas向麾下一位中尉报信、由对方替两人打掩护，罗莉则忧心科拉以为被抛下而惊慌。
facts.anchor: “To you, yes.” His phrasing made my heart clench. “You needn’t worry, my lady. I will send Stolas with word of what happened to one of my lieutenants, and he will cover for both of us.”
